effects.effect: You have a +10 [bonus](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bonuses-and-penalties) to the [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) of your [ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) abilities. Additionally, you don't need [line of effect](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/line-of-effect) to a target of a [ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) ability if the target is a creature capable of thought who you have previously had [line of effect](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/line-of-effect) to.
